description: Returns the status and link of a published post, by platform and the post id returned when it was published. For TikTok and YouTube it asks the platform for the processing status and returns the public link once there is one. For networks that publish immediately it returns status "published" and, where the id allows it, the post's link (Telegram channels, including private ones as t.me/c/<channel>/<message>; Bluesky; LinkedIn; Facebook).

brand_id.description: Brand whose account published it; omit for the default brand.

id.description: The post id returned when it was published on that platform.

name: get_post_status
title: Check a post's publishing status
